title: The Fallen Throne
summary: Mastering the Sovereign Domain, Ha-Jun explores the ancient Throne of Asmodaius, discovering the hidden mechanism leading into the Sacred Memory Chamber beneath the summit.

panels.shot: 500-meter sovereign domain sphere shimmering wide shot
panels.action: A massive translucent violet sphere of sovereign authority encloses the entire summit plateau.
panels.prose_en: A massive translucent violet sphere of sovereign authority encloses the entire summit plateau.
panels.prose_hi: Samprabhu satta ka ek vishal parabhasi baingani kshetra poore shikhar pathar ko gherta hai.

panels.shot: gravity and atmospheric pressure bending inside domain
panels.action: Loose diamond dust and stone pebbles float weightlessly in midair within the boundaries of the domain.
panels.prose_en: Loose diamond dust and stone pebbles float weightlessly in midair within the boundaries of the domain.
panels.prose_hi: Domen ki seemaon ke bhitar dheele heere ki dhul aur patthar ke kankad hawa mein bharahin roop se tairte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun descending throne steps with effortless grace
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps down the marble staircase, Crown gleaming, his dark coat rustling with sovereign dignity.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps down the marble staircase, Crown gleaming, his dark coat rustling with sovereign dignity.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sangmarmar ki sidhi se neeche utarta hai, uska mukut chamak raha hai, uska kala coat samprabhu garima ke saath sarsra raha hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun standing up and smiling warmly
panels.action: Tae-Jun clasps his younger brother's hand: 'Tumhara domain... Maine aisi presence 7 saalo mein nahi dekhi.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Poori mountain tumhare rhythm par saans le rahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun clasps his younger brother's hand: 'Tumhara domain... Maine aisi presence 7 saalo mein nahi dekhi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun apne chhote bhai ka haath pakadte han: 'tumhara domen... maine aisi upasthiti 7 saalon mein nahin dekhi.'

panels.shot: ha-jun dispelling the floating stones with a flick
panels.action: With a subtle twitch of his ring finger, the floating stones settle gently back onto the ground.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh Crown bas weapon nahi hai... Yeh is realm ka steering wheel hai.

panels.prose_en: With a subtle twitch of his ring finger, the floating stones settle gently back onto the ground.
panels.prose_hi: Uski anamika ungli ke ek sookshm jhatke se, tairte hue patthar dheere se wapas jameen par baith jaate han.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto the throne backrest
panels.action: Kuro pecks at a hidden demonic crest carved into the obsidian backrest: 'Lekin Asmodaius ka asli treasure niche hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Throne ke theek niche The Sacred Memory Chamber hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro pecks at a hidden demonic crest carved into the obsidian backrest: 'Lekin Asmodaius ka asli treasure niche hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro obsidian backarest mein khudi hui ek chipi hui rakshasi shikha par chonch maarta hai: 'lakin esmodius ka asli khajana neeche hai!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun examining the throne seat
panels.action: In the center of the dark seat: an intricate nine-pointed star depression matching Ha-Jun's Sovereign Crest.
panels.prose_en: In the center of the dark seat: an intricate nine-pointed star depression matching Ha-Jun's Sovereign Crest.
panels.prose_hi: Andhere seat ke kendra men: ha-jun ke sovereign crest se mail khane wala ek jatil nau-nukila tara avsad.

panels.shot: ha-jun pressing right palm onto the star depression
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses his bare palm into the depression, conducting a pulse of crimson blood mana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun presses his bare palm into the depression, conducting a pulse of crimson blood mana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni nangi hatheli ko avsad mein dabata hai, jisse lal rakt man ki ek naadi sanchalit hoti hai.

panels.shot: thunderous grinding of ancient gears inside the mountain
panels.action: Deep inside Mount Obsidian, colossal subterranean counterweights shift with seismic rumbles.
panels.prose_en: Deep inside Mount Obsidian, colossal subterranean counterweights shift with seismic rumbles.
panels.prose_hi: Mount obsidian ke ander, vishal bhumigat countervate bhukampiy gadgdahat ke saath badalte han.

panels.shot: central throne splitting and parting into two halves
panels.action: The 40-foot obsidian throne splits down the middle, sliding apart along concealed bronze tracks.
panels.prose_en: The 40-foot obsidian throne splits down the middle, sliding apart along concealed bronze tracks.
panels.prose_hi: 40 foot ka obsidian sinhasan beech mein vibhajit ho jata hai, chipi hui kansya patriyon ke saath fisalta hua alag ho jata hai.

panels.shot: circular descending staircase of crystal revealed
panels.action: Beneath the throne opens a 20-foot wide circular staircase of glowing amethyst steps spiraling down.
panels.prose_en: Beneath the throne opens a 20-foot wide circular staircase of glowing amethyst steps spiraling down.
panels.prose_hi: Sinhasan ke neeche ek 20 foot chaudi golakar sidhi khulti hai jisme chamakti hui neelam ki sidhiyan neeche ki or ghumti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun peering into the glowing subterranean depths
panels.action: Cool, scented air smelling of ancient scrolls and cedarwood wafts upward from the illuminated depths.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hazaaron saal purani kitabo ki khushboo... Yeh koi dungeon nahi hai, yeh library hai.

panels.prose_en: Cool, scented air smelling of ancient scrolls and cedarwood wafts upward from the illuminated depths.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin scroll aur devdar ki lakdi ki mahak wali thandi, sugandhit hawa roshan gahrai se upar ki or aati hai.

panels.shot: kuro flying down first as scout
panels.action: Kuro glides into the opening: 'The Memory Archives of Asmodaius! Jahan universe ka sach band hai!'
panels.prose_en: Kuro glides into the opening: 'The Memory Archives of Asmodaius! Jahan universe ka sach band hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne shuruaat mein kaha: 'd memory archives off esmodius! jahan brahmand ka sach band hai!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun descending the amethyst steps
panels.action: The two brothers walk side-by-side down the luminous purple crystal spiral staircase.
panels.prose_en: The two brothers walk side-by-side down the luminous purple crystal spiral staircase.
panels.prose_hi: Donon bhai chamakdar baingani crystal sarpil sidhi ke sath-sath chalte han.

panels.shot: walls lined with millions of floating crystal memory orbs
panels.action: The subterranean hall opens into a colossal hollow cavern lined with millions of glowing data spheres.
panels.prose_en: The subterranean hall opens into a colossal hollow cavern lined with millions of glowing data spheres.
panels.prose_hi: Bhumigat hall lakhon chamakte data kshetron se susajjit ek vishal khokhli gufa mein khulta hai.

panels.shot: central holographic pedestal in the archive chamber
panels.action: In the heart of the archives: a crystalline dais projecting a 3D star map of the mortal and abyssal realms.
panels.prose_en: In the heart of the archives: a crystalline dais projecting a 3D star map of the mortal and abyssal realms.
panels.prose_hi: Abhilekhagar ke kendra men: ek crystaliy manch jo nashwar aur rasatal kshetron ka 3d sitara manchitra prastut karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping up to the central star map
panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches out to touch the holographic representation of Earth and the Abyss linked by red lines.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Earth aur Demon Realm... Pehle ek hi universe ka hissa the?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches out to touch the holographic representation of Earth and the Abyss linked by red lines.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun lal rekhaon se jude prithvi aur rasatal ke holographic pratinidhitva ko chhune ke liye pahunchta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun reading an ancient holographic text
panels.action: Tae-Jun swipes through floating cuneiform symbols: 'Haan... 10,000 saal pehle tak koi Gate nahi tha.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Dono realms ek saath exist karte the... Jab tak 'The Void Primordial' nahi aaya.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun swipes through floating cuneiform symbols: 'Haan... 10,000 saal pehle tak koi Gate nahi tha.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun floating cuniform pratikon ke madhyam se swipe karta hai: 'han... 10,000 saal pehle tak koi gate nahin tha.'

panels.shot: ha-jun turning sharply to tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks up: 'The Void Primordial... Yeh kaun hai?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Asmodaius ne bhi is entity ka naam liya tha.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks up: 'The Void Primordial... Yeh kaun hai?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun upar dekhta hai: 'd void primordial... yeh kaun hai?'.

panels.shot: kuro expression turning somber and dark
panels.action: Kuro lands on the pedestal: 'Woh entity kisi realm ki nahi hai... Woh universal entropy ka avatar hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The Void Primordial har universe ke mana ko devour karta hai jab tak sabkuch black na ho jaye.

panels.prose_en: Kuro lands on the pedestal: 'Woh entity kisi realm ki nahi hai... Woh universal entropy ka avatar hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro is paaydaan par hai: 'vo ikai kisi dayre ki nahin hai... woh universal entropy ka avtar hai.'

panels.shot: archive orb projecting historical memory hologram
panels.action: A glowing gold orb projects a colossal memory playback in the center of the chamber.
panels.prose_en: A glowing gold orb projects a colossal memory playback in the center of the chamber.
panels.prose_hi: Ek chamakta hua sone ka gola kaksh ke kendra mein ek vishal memory playback prastut karta hai.

panels.shot: hologram showing the first sovereign in his prime
panels.action: Lord Asmodaius, a towering emperor in midnight armor with four horns, presiding over a golden civilization.
panels.prose_en: Lord Asmodaius, a towering emperor in midnight armor with four horns, presiding over a golden civilization.
panels.prose_hi: Lord esmodius, char seengon wala aadhi raat ke kavach mein ek vishal samrat, ek sunhari sabhyata ka netritva kar raha tha.

panels.shot: seven demon kings kneeling before asmodaius
panels.action: Seven crowned demon lords swearing absolute fealty before the Sovereign's throne.

dialogue.text: Seven Demon Kings Sovereign ke sabse faithful generals the... Lekin Void ne unke dimaago mein poison daal diya.

panels.prose_en: Seven crowned demon lords swearing absolute fealty before the Sovereign's throne.
panels.prose_hi: Saat mukutdhari rakshas shasakon ne samprabhu ke sinhasan ke samaksh purna nishtha ki shapath li.

panels.shot: black void worms infecting the demon kings' brains
panels.action: Terrifying microscopic black parasites burrowing into the demon kings' eyes, turning them into puppets.
panels.prose_en: Terrifying microscopic black parasites burrowing into the demon kings' eyes, turning them into puppets.
panels.prose_hi: Bhayanak sookshm kale parjivi rakshas rajaon ki aankhon mein ghuskar unhen kathputliyon mein badal dete han.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring in shock at the parasite footage
panels.action: Ha-Jun covers his mouth: 'Woh demon kings evil nahi the... Woh mind-controlled the!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: The Seven Kings were infected by the Void!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun covers his mouth: 'Woh demon kings evil nahi the... Woh mind-controlled the!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apna munh dhak liya: 'vo rakshas raja dusht nahin the... woh man-niyantrit the!'

panels.shot: tae-jun pointing to the infection records
panels.action: Tae-Jun highlights a medical file: 'Director Kang ke laboratory mein wahi same parasite mila tha!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Hunter Bureau bhi usi Void Cult ka tool thi, Ha-Jun! Same infection!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun highlights a medical file: 'Director Kang ke laboratory mein wahi same parasite mila tha!'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ne ek medical file par prakash dala: 'nirdeshak kang ke prayogshala mein wahi parjivi mila tha!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun realization dawning like lightning
panels.action: Everything connects in Ha-Jun's mind: humans, demons, hunters—all manipulated by the same unseen horror.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Asli dushman na Humans the na Demons... Asli dushman 'The Void' hai!

panels.prose_en: Everything connects in Ha-Jun's mind: humans, demons, hunters—all manipulated by the same unseen horror.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke dimag mein sab kuch judta hai: manushya, rakshs, shikari - sabhi ek hi andekhi bhayavahata se prabhavit hote han.

panels.shot: a second secret vault door in the archive floor
panels.action: Behind the star map pedestal, a circular hatch engraved with an eclipse crescent glows pitch-black.
panels.prose_en: Behind the star map pedestal, a circular hatch engraved with an eclipse crescent glows pitch-black.
panels.prose_hi: Star map pedstal ke pichhe, grahan ardhchandra ke saath utkeern ek golakar hatch bilkul kale rang mein chamakta hai.

panels.shot: kuro pointing to the crescent hatch
panels.action: Kuro spreads his wings: 'Wahan rests the second Legendary Relic: Eclipse Devourer!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The Void-slaying blade! The Eclipse Devourer!

panels.prose_en: Kuro spreads his wings: 'Wahan rests the second Legendary Relic: Eclipse Devourer!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne pankh failaye: 'vahan dusre pauranik avashesh par vishram kar raha hai: grahan bhakshak!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking toward the eclipse hatch with drawn breath
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps up to the dark portal, his Crown resonating with ancient anticipation.
panels.mood: ready for the blade of eclipse

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Let us forge the blade that will end the Void.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps up to the dark portal, his Crown resonating with ancient anticipation.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun andhere portal ki or badhta hai, uska mukut prachin pratyasha se gunjata hai.
